evidence.observation: H701 reads 275.204 °C versus H702 at 63.944 °C and reboiler at 53.946 °C, an isolated large heater-temperature discrepancy.
Discrepancy persists: H701 is 285.099 °C, H702 70.194 °C, and reboiler 60.166 °C; readings alone cannot distinguish actual localized overheating from temperature-sensor error.

Pressure remains near its initial value at 498.933 mbar; differential pressures are 0.702 and 2.131 mbar, with distillate, reflux, and cooling-water flows present and no corresponding abrupt process excursion.

args.missing_evidence: H701/H702 setpoints, heater power and permitted temperature limits, plus an independent H701 temperature measurement to distinguish expected heater asymmetry, overheating, and sensor error; composition measurement and target specification are needed to assess separation.
